description:
Life On Planet’s latest remix package of 'Only You' calls on a diverse roster of talent from across the globe. 

Colombia's Dudu Bembé takes Planets' cover of Steve Monite’s classic, “Only You,” and reinterprets the groove in a contemporary Afrobeat direction while Cape Town's, Jude Brown beefs the tune-up with a driving house remix. Zooming over to Asia, we welcome Israeli-Singaporean, Hong Kong transplant, Orio, who takes things in an epic, dubbed-out, and extended direction.

On “Brother," Charlie Soul Clap puts his heart into it with his signature bassline touch, soulful chords inspired by his 90’s roots, and a love for all things Teddy Riley.

Candian house music, heavy-hitter, Fred Everything, infects the groove with bubbling synths and his distinct brand of finely tuned flavors. Berliner, super talent, and R&S Records label mate, Afriqua, elevates the track to avant-garde heights with his VeeAyy Garaj Mix. 

Some words about the release from Life On Planets: 
“We have to come together during these challenging times and I'm very proud of my friends' hard work on this EP. With the power of music, we can move through the darkness and hopefully inspire each other to move things forward."
